name: China
dek: Beijing, WMO 54511. One capital station, not a national average.
paragraphs: The reference station is Beijing, WMO 54511, height 32.5 m. Shanghai, Guangzhou, Lhasa, and the far west have their own files and were not averaged in; this is a Beijing table, not a national climate. CDC's traveler page states that tap water is not drinkable, even in major cities; the sheet quotes that sentence. No official tipping page was opened on this pass, so that line is missing.

The highest average high in the table is 31.8 °C, in July. The lowest average low is -6.9 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is July, at 169.7 mm, and the driest is January and December, at 2.2 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Beijing, WMO 54511. Not Shanghai, not a national average, and not the high plateau or the far south.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and I, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows China at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 35 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Road Traffic Safety, in the English translation published by the Supreme People's Court, says motor vehicles and non-motor vehicles shall keep to the right of the road.
driving.sourceTitle: Law of the People's Republic of China on Road Traffic Safety, Article 35 (Supreme People's Court English text)

water.label: Tap water
water.value: Not drinkable, even in major cities, according to CDC
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for China, last reviewed August 25, 2026, says: "Tap water is not drinkable in China, even in major cities. Bottled water is easily available." This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Yuan Renminbi and the code CNY for China.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.value: Asia/Shanghai for Beijing Time; Asia/Urumqi for Xinjiang Time
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give China two rows: Asia/Shanghai, commented Beijing Time, and Asia/Urumqi, commented Xinjiang Time. The Beijing sheet uses Asia/Shanghai; it is not a single national zone.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The National Immigration Administration site. We do not restate a visa rule.
